overview.name: T-Rex 2X Long Lite Daily Target ETF
overview.description: Under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that are designed to provide, in the aggregate, 200% exposure to the price performance of LITE on a daily basis. The fund is non-diversified.
